title: Step prescribed by an input-only action
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be an input word, and let $c$ be a configuration whose state is $q$. If the transition of $M$ at state $q$, on the symbols currently scanned on the input and work tapes, is the action that moves the input head by a sign $m$, leaves all work tapes and their heads unchanged, emits no output, and enters state $q'$, then one step from $c$ has state $q'$ and input-head position obtained by moving the current position by $m$ with the prescribed boundary clamping.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes
The transition at $q$ on the currently scanned symbols equals the specified input-only action with movement $m$ and successor state $q'$
